patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I fell asleep at the beach and now my shoulders and back are bright red and sore. No blisters really, just red and hot. My wife told me to get it checked.
clinical.presentationShort: 34yo M — superficial (1st-degree) sunburn to shoulders/back, no blistering, no systemic symptoms — minor.
clinical.presentationLong: 34-year-old male with a superficial first-degree sunburn across the shoulders and back, no blistering and no systemic symptoms.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → cool compresses, moisturizer, NSAIDs, sun precautions; reassurance.
diagnosis.why: Red, no blisters, no systemic signs = superficial burn. Supportive care and reassurance — this one's a go-home.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image.
